start.title: [TODO:ru] Famine in the Land
start.text:
[TODO:ru] Foreigners come daily for grain.
A new group bows before your dais.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wave them off, you are busy

wave_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Look Again
wave_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Something pulls your eye back.
Those beards, that posture…

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step down from the dais.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Steady Yourself
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their voices reach you. Hebrew.
Your heart begins to pound.

recognize.title: [TODO:ru] It Is Them
recognize.text:
[TODO:ru] Reuben. Judah. Levi. All ten.
They do not know you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide your face and test them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You must know if they have changed.

reveal_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Too Soon
reveal_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their hearts are not yet known.
Is Benjamin safe? Is father alive?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide your face and test them

arrest_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] A Cold Heart
arrest_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Anger burns — but God put you here
for more than revenge.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide your face and test them

hide_face.title: [TODO:ru] A Stranger's Voice
hide_face.text:
[TODO:ru] Through an interpreter you speak harsh.
"Where do you come from?"

skip_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hold the Plan
skip_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] If you skip the test now,
you will never know their hearts.

spy_accusation.title: [TODO:ru] "You Are Spies!"
spy_accusation.text:
[TODO:ru] You point and roar the word.
The brothers fall to their knees.

smile_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Mask On
smile_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] You must not soften yet.
The test is only beginning.

they_protest.title: [TODO:ru] Their Defense
they_protest.text:
[TODO:ru] "We are twelve sons. One is no more.
The youngest is with our father."

pretend_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Steady
pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Without Benjamin, the test fails.
You must press on.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Bite Your Tongue
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Mocking the lost wounds father too.
You pull the words back.

demand_benjamin.title: [TODO:ru] Three Days' Hold
demand_benjamin.text:
[TODO:ru] "You will be held three days.
Then one fetches the youngest."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Lock them all in the chamber

free_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hold the Line
free_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Without pressure, the truth hides.
Three days will reveal much.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Lock them all in the chamber

three_days.title: [TODO:ru] Third Morning
three_days.text:
[TODO:ru] Three days have weighed on them.
Now you offer a softer terms.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Keep one, send the rest with grain

all_stay_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Be Just
all_stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their wives and children would die.
God would not honor that.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Keep one, send the rest with grain

keep_one.title: [TODO:ru] Their Confession
keep_one.text:
[TODO:ru] They speak among themselves, not knowing
you understand every word.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Listen
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] These are the words you waited
twenty years to hear.

overhear.title: [TODO:ru] "This Is For Joseph"
overhear.text:
[TODO:ru] "We sinned against our brother.
We saw his anguish and would not hear."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Show your tears in front of them

tears_open_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Not Yet
tears_open_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] They would see and the test
would be undone too soon.

weep_alone.title: [TODO:ru] Choose Simeon
weep_alone.text:
[TODO:ru] You return composed. Now choose
which brother to hold.

reuben_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Not Reuben
reuben_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Reuben spoke for you long ago.
Let justice fall on another.

bind_simeon.title: [TODO:ru] Simeon Bound
bind_simeon.text:
[TODO:ru] Ropes circle his wrists. He goes
without protest. The brothers pale.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Order their sacks filled with grain
[TODO:ru] Send them empty, to teach a lesson

empty_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Mercy Returns
empty_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Famine kills children too.
Give them what they came for.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Order their sacks filled with grain

fill_sacks.title: [TODO:ru] Silver Returned
fill_sacks.text:
[TODO:ru] You whisper to the steward:
"Put each man's silver back in his sack."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Take the silver as fair pay
[TODO:ru] Hide it deep within the grain
[TODO:ru] Toss it openly into their cart

silver_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] No Profit
silver_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] You will not take from your father's house.
Return it in secret.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide it deep within the grain

open_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hidden, Not Open
open_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] An open gift would frighten them.
Better discovered later.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide it deep within the grain

silver_hidden.title: [TODO:ru] Provision for the Road
silver_hidden.text:
[TODO:ru] The steward also packs food
for the long journey home.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send them off with no warning

no_warning_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Make It Clear
no_warning_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] If they forget the terms,
the test cannot be completed.

send_off.title: [TODO:ru] They Depart
send_off.text:
[TODO:ru] Donkeys laden, the nine ride out.
From your window, you watch.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Run after them and confess all

run_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hold the Plan
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Father's heart, Benjamin's safety —
the test must be finished.

first_camp.title: [TODO:ru] Camp at Dusk
first_camp.text:
[TODO:ru] Far away, the brothers stop.
One opens his sack for grain.

silver_found.title: [TODO:ru] "What Has God Done?"
silver_found.text:
[TODO:ru] They tremble. "What is this God
has done to us?" they cry.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] They will turn back in panic

press_on.title: [TODO:ru] Onward to Canaan
press_on.text:
[TODO:ru] Fear pushes them home.
Father is waiting.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Speak True
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Father will see the missing son.
A lie will only deepen the pain.

tell_jacob.title: [TODO:ru] Father Hears
tell_jacob.text:
[TODO:ru] Jacob's hand trembles at his chest.
"Joseph is gone. Simeon now too…"

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Be Gentle
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Shouting will not heal a father
who has buried a son in his heart.

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Stay With Him
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Leaving solves nothing.
Father needs a steady son now.

promise_jacob.title: [TODO:ru] Jacob Refuses
promise_jacob.text:
[TODO:ru] "My son shall not go down with you."
The grain bag empties slowly.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Wait for the famine to speak.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wait until the grain runs out

force_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Patience
force_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Father will not be forced.
God's time will come.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wait until the grain runs out

wait_famine.title: [TODO:ru] Sacks Run Empty
wait_famine.text:
[TODO:ru] Weeks pass. The last grain is gone.
Father summons his sons.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stay silent and let Reuben speak
[TODO:ru] Boast you can fix it alone

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Quiet, Brother
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Father needs a pledge, not a boast.
Let Judah speak.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stay silent and let Judah speak

judah_speaks.title: [TODO:ru] Judah's Pledge
judah_speaks.text:
[TODO:ru] "Send the boy with me. I will be
surety. On me alone the blame."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His pledge is a true one.

mock_judah_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hush
mock_judah_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] This is the moment of pledge.
Do not break it with mockery.

father_relents.title: [TODO:ru] "If I Am Bereaved…"
father_relents.text:
[TODO:ru] "Take double silver. Take a gift.
And may God Almighty give you mercy."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Father said double — and a gift.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Prepare double silver and a gift

stingy_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Honor Father
stingy_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Father has spoken with care.
Obey him in full.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Prepare double silver and a gift

preparation.title: [TODO:ru] Donkeys Loaded
preparation.text:
[TODO:ru] Benjamin tightens his sash.
The road south waits in the dust.

no_pray_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Pray First
no_pray_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Egypt is far. The vizier is harsh.
Ask God's mercy now.

ending.title: [TODO:ru] Toward Egypt Again
ending.text:
[TODO:ru] Eleven brothers ride south.
A strange vizier waits — and watches.
